found.quote: When using a Generative AI tool to correct grammar and syntax, you should not copy and paste large amounts of your own writing into the tool.

Plagiarism can occur in all types of assessment when a Student claims as their own, intentionally or by omission, work which was not done by that Student. This may occur in a number of ways e.g. copying and pasting material, adapting material and self-plagiarism.
